quests.name: Pests in the Forecourt
quests.text: Welcome to the Chinese, friend. I'd shake your hand but I've a theatre full of vermin. Those pale ones, the Workers, are carrying off my forecourt a brick at a time. They don't bite unless you start it. Start it. Six of them ought to make my point.
quests.complete_text: Six fewer. I can nearly hear the box office again. You'll do, kid.

quests.name: Plates for Mr. Factor
quests.text: You have steady hands, I can tell. The shell of these creatures grinds to a powder finer than anything I can import. Bring me five plates off the Workers, cracked is no matter, and I will show you what a chemist can do with a nuisance.
quests.complete_text: Yes. Yes, this will grind beautifully. Thank you.

quests.name: A Note for the Roosevelt

objectives.label: Deliver the note to the Roosevelt front desk

quests.text: The Roosevelt across the way is holding rooms for my ushers and Pennington at the desk wants it in writing. Everything in writing, that man. Take him this note. Mind the streetcar tracks.
quests.complete_text: From Mr. Grauman? In writing, good. If you need a bed, a meal or a quiet hour, the Roosevelt is open to anyone fighting for the boulevard.

quests.name: Dogs on Franklin
quests.text: Our guests on the north side can't sleep for the howling. The dogs on Franklin went wild the week the sky closed and they hunt in packs now. Thin them out, eight would do, and the hotel will see you're paid.
quests.complete_text: A quiet night at last. The hotel is obliged to you.

quests.name: Coyote Country
quests.text: Coyotes have come down out of the hills as far as Franklin and Wilcox. The housekeeper says a good pelt makes a better blanket than anything we can get through the dome. Eight coyotes, and four pelts fit to use.
quests.complete_text: These will keep somebody warm. Well done.

quests.name: The Newsreel Truck
quests.text: A Fox Movietone truck went over on Cahuenga, down by Selma, the night it all started. There is footage in those cans of the first hour and I mean to show it. Bring me six cans. The alleys there are crawling, so step lively.
quests.complete_text: Six cans, and not a dent that matters. Someday people will want to see this.

quests.name: Light the Boulevard
quests.text: A dark boulevard belongs to them. A lit one belongs to us. There are four arc lamps between here and Wilcox that still have carbon in them. Strike them up, all four, and let the things see we're open for business.
quests.complete_text: Look at that. You can read a marquee from Highland again.

quests.name: Selma Avenue Sweep
quests.text: The Drones are a different animal from the Workers. They come at you, and they bring their friends. The alleys off Selma, behind the Egyptian, are thick with them. Ten would give my ushers room to breathe.
quests.complete_text: Ten Drones. You're earning a name on this street.

quests.name: Old Scar
quests.text: There's one coyote the bellhops have a name for. Old Scar. Big grey brute, hunts alone up past Franklin on the east end, and he's taken two of the hotel's dogs. I'd count it a personal favour.
quests.complete_text: Old Scar himself? The bellhops will want to hear it from you.

quests.name: An Introduction at the Taft

objectives.label: Speak to the auctioneer at the Taft Building

quests.text: You've been picking things up off those creatures. Don't sell it all to shopkeepers. Cornelius Vane runs the auction floor at the Taft Building, Hollywood and Vine, and everyone on the hill sells through him. Tell him Sid sent you.
quests.complete_text: Grauman's word is good here. Everything that comes off a studio lot, a hive or a dead man's back is sold on this floor. Browse the listings, bid as you please.

quests.name: Glands for the Drugstore
quests.text: I do not hold with liquor, but I hold with medicine. The yellow ones that spit carry a gland that makes a first-rate burn salve. They roost above Cahuenga, south of the boulevard. Bring me eight, and wear gloves.
quests.complete_text: Eight, and intact. There will be salve at the aid stations by morning.

quests.name: Behind the Taft
quests.text: It ain't only bugs. There's men behind this building stripping the back lots and selling to whoever. They shot at the night porter. Eight of them gone and the rest'll find another block.
quests.complete_text: That's the back lots quiet. The building thanks you, and so do I.

quests.name: Coffee for the Derby
quests.text: No trucks come through that dome, so what's in my storeroom is all the coffee there is. Trouble is the storeroom door's gone and the tins are scattered round the back of the Derby. Ten tins and the whole street stays awake.
quests.complete_text: Ten tins. I could kiss you. Have a cup instead.

quests.name: The Stagehand

objectives.label: Find Whitey Nolan in the Cahuenga alleys

quests.text: My best stagehand, Whitey Nolan, went down Cahuenga for lumber two days ago. Somebody saw him holed up past Selma with those spitting things all around. Find him and tell him the Pantages still has a job for him.
quests.complete_text: You're from the Pantages? Thank God. I've been sat on this lumber two days with them things clicking on the roof. I'll come, but I'm not walking it alone.

quests.name: Whitey Comes Home

objectives.label: Bring Whitey Nolan back to the Pantages

quests.text: Right. You go first and I'll keep behind you. Those spitting things will come down off the roofs when they hear us, so don't let them get at me. I'm a stagehand, not a fighter. Pantages loading door, Hollywood and Argyle.
quests.complete_text: Whitey! Look at you. Get inside, there's coffee. You brought him back through all that? The show goes up Friday, and you're in the best seat.

quests.name: Rooftop Spitters
quests.text: The Spitters above Cahuenga can hit my loading door from the rooftops. I have had two scenery flats burned through. Six of them, if you please, before they start on the marquee.
quests.complete_text: The loading door is safe. You have a friend at the Pantages.

quests.name: Charges on the Spires
quests.text: See those spires going up south of Selma? Every one of them hatches a Drone on the half minute. I got charges from a powder man at Columbia. Set them on three spires and stand well back.
quests.complete_text: Three spires down. That'll slow the hatching.

quests.name: Report to Chief Davis

objectives.label: Report to Chief Davis at the Hollywood police station

quests.text: The Chief of Police himself has set up at the Hollywood station on Wilcox. He asked me for anyone who can handle themselves, and you can. Go and see him. Stand up straight when you do.
quests.complete_text: Grauman sent you? Then you can shoot or you can run, and I need both. Hollywood High is a nest and I mean to clean it out.

quests.name: The School Gates
quests.text: Hollywood High, Sunset and Highland. The Drones hold the east gates. I want ten of them dead before I send a single officer through. This department does not lose men to insects.
quests.complete_text: The gates are open. Good work.

quests.name: Broodlings
quests.text: The small ones in the schoolyard come in swarms. Any one of them is nothing. Fifteen of them have a man off his feet in a moment. Kill fifteen, and don't let them get round behind you.
quests.complete_text: Fifteen. They'll hatch more, but not today.

quests.name: Call-box Keys
quests.text: Every call box on Sunset has a key hanging in it and every key opens every box. I can't have looters ringing the station at all hours. Fetch me five keys off the Sunset boxes.
quests.complete_text: Five keys. That's five boxes they can't play games with.

quests.name: The Ringleader
quests.text: The looters behind the Taft take orders from one man, Knuckles Malone. He works out of the lot at the far east end. My squad has a file on him an inch thick. Close the file.
quests.complete_text: Malone's finished? I'll mark the file.

quests.name: The Gymnasium
quests.text: They are laying in the school gymnasium. Egg clusters, wall to wall. Burn eight of them. If we leave it a week there will be no taking that school back.
quests.complete_text: Eight clusters. That's a few hundred we won't have to shoot.

quests.name: Soldiers on the Field
quests.text: The armoured ones on the athletic field are their regulars. Bullets skip off them. Six dead Soldiers would tell me whether this town can be held. Take help if you can find it.
quests.complete_text: Six Soldiers. Then it can be done.

quests.name: The Ballroom Brute
quests.text: There is something the size of a delivery truck nesting in the ballroom of the Hollywood Hotel. It walked through the north wall. No one man is going to kill it. Raise a party and bring it down.
quests.complete_text: The ballroom is ours. The hotel will want to give a dance.

quests.name: Clear the Egyptian
quests.text: I built the Egyptian before I built this place. Opened it with Fairbanks in Robin Hood, in 'twenty-two. Now there's a queen of some kind on my stage. You'll want four friends. Go in through the courtyard and give me back my theatre.
quests.complete_text: She's dead? On my stage? Kid, the Egyptian reopens Friday and your name goes on the marquee.

quests.name: Five Reels of Robin Hood
quests.text: The print of Robin Hood is still up in the Egyptian's projection booth. Five reels I care about. Nitrate burns if you look at it wrong, so carry them like eggs.
quests.complete_text: All five. We'll run it the night the Egyptian reopens.

quests.name: The Ushers
quests.text: Four of Grauman's ushers were taken alive into the Egyptian. The creatures keep people to work the place. Find them, cut them loose and send them out the front.
quests.complete_text: All four walked out. Good.

quests.name: Scrap Drive
quests.text: I can't cast a bullet out of good intentions. The wrecks in the back lots are full of steel and brass. Learn to salvage, Ike Brandt at Vine will show you if you ask, and bring me ten loads of scrap.
quests.complete_text: That's a week of cartridges. Much obliged.

quests.name: Rounds for the Line
quests.text: Salvage is half of it. The other half is the bench. I'll teach you to load a cartridge if you've the patience, and the boys at the forecourt need every round they can get. Make twenty .38s and bring them here so I can check your crimp.
quests.complete_text: Nice even crimp. You'd pass at Winchester. Keep at the bench, there's a lot more to learn.

quests.name: Hold the Line
quests.text: I held a trench at Belleau Wood with a club I made from a fence post, because a rifle jams and a club doesn't. The armoured ones on the Hollywood High field are the closest thing to a German line you'll see. Kill eight of them, up close, and I'll give you that club.
quests.complete_text: Eight. You stood your ground. Take it. It's been through worse than you have.

quests.name: Falling for a Living
quests.text: Any fool can take a fall. A stuntman takes a fall and gets up swinging. The school gates are crawling with Drones and the yard is knee deep in the little ones. Go in fast, get knocked down, get up. Ten of each and you've earned my gloves.
quests.complete_text: You're still in one piece. That's the whole job, kid. Wear these, they're weighted with buckshot.

quests.name: Trophy Shots
quests.text: A man who can hit a playing card at thirty paces works in pictures. A man who can hit a Soldier through the joint in its armour works for me. Bring me six mandibles off the Soldiers on the school field, and I'll know you didn't buy them.
quests.complete_text: Clean through the joint, every one. The studio armourer let me have this Winchester for whoever earned it. That's you.

quests.name: Hot Wire
quests.text: The Soldiers carry a cord down their backs that hums when you hold it near a lamp. I think they talk with it, like a telephone line. Bring me six and I'll find out what they're saying. Mind your fingers, it bites.
quests.complete_text: Six, and still humming. Here, a reflector off a klieg light from the Lasky lot. It throws a beam you could read by on the moon.

quests.name: A Bigger Bang
quests.text: Ike's charges on the spires are a good start, but a spire's no use dead if the Soldiers just guard the hole. Blow three spires south of Selma, then go and make four Soldiers sorry on the school field. Pack the charge tight. Tight is everything.
quests.complete_text: I heard the third one from here. Take my tamping bar. Pack them tight.

quests.name: Antivenom
quests.text: Half the boys we see at the aid station have broodling bites gone green. If I had the venom I could make an antivenom, the way they do for rattlers. Eight sacs, from the schoolyard. Don't squeeze them.
quests.complete_text: Eight, and none burst. I'll have the first doses tonight. This satchel came from Queen of Angels, it's yours now.

quests.name: The Lost Flock
quests.text: There were children at that school. They got out, thank the Lord, but the things that hatched in the yard are still there and the parents want to go back for what they left. Clear a path through the yard so they can. Fifteen of the small ones and six of the Drones at the gates.
quests.complete_text: The families went in this morning. They're praying for you by name. Carry this Bible, it rode a circuit through three states before it came to me.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.text: The looters behind the Taft have been stripping every car on Vine for parts. Carburettors, magnetos, the lot. There's a fire engine at the station that won't run without them. Get me back eight parts and I'll get the engine running.
quests.complete_text: That's a magneto, a carb and a starter in there. The engine will run by Sunday. Have the crank handle. A Model T never let anybody down if they knew how to swing one.

quests.name: Word from Melrose

objectives.label: Report to the Hollywood Cemetery gate in Melrose

quests.text: You've outgrown my boulevard. The people at the Hollywood Cemetery gate, down in Melrose, are asking for help with the crypts. It's a hard road south through the wall. Don't go alone.

quests.name: Extras Wanted

objectives.label: Report to the Columbia gate in Gower Gulch

quests.text: Columbia is hiring anyone who can hold a gun, down at Sunset and Gower. The cowboys call it Gower Gulch. East through the wall, if you can get past what guards it.

quests.name: The Legion Is Calling

objectives.label: Report to Post 43 in Cahuenga Pass

quests.text: Post 43 holds the clubhouse up Highland with a German field gun and not much else. They want experienced hands. It is thirty levels of trouble north of here. Go when you are ready, not before.
